name: door-iron-powered
comment: BlockDoor.onNeighborBlockChange / onPoweredBlockChange and BlockTrapDoor.onNeighborBlockChange / onPoweredBlockChange: an iron door at x=2 and a wooden door at x=4 (lower half meta 0, upper meta 8); a trapdoor at (3,61,1), meta 2, hanging on a stone block at x+1; a trapdoor at (3,61,3), meta 1, whose support at z-1 is the torch's cell (set_block never notifies the block itself). A lit redstone torch (id 76) set between the doors at t=2 (a power source: Block.canProvidePower; BlockTorch.onBlockAdded gives it meta 5) opens both doors through isBlockIndirectlyGettingPowered and the hanging trapdoor through onPoweredBlockChange; the floating trapdoor, notified with the torch's id, is removed and dropped and then, the vanilla bug of BlockTrapDoor.java:115-123 (no return after the removal), onPoweredBlockChange runs on the now empty cell next to the powering torch and sets its metadata to 4 (the cell is away from the doors, so the torch's notification is the first it gets). Removing the torch at t=6 closes the doors (their upper halves are among the cells BlockRedstoneTorch.onBlockRemoval notifies with the torch's id, and forward it to the lower halves) but leaves the hanging trapdoor open: it is notified only by setBlockWithNotify, with the new id 0, and the power branch needs neighborId > 0 (BlockTrapDoor.java:120). Needs BlockRedstoneTorch (redstone task of WP-1.6).
